name: local-agent
description: Use ChatGPT, GitHub, the ChatGPT sandbox, and an optional Local Agent executor as one bounded development workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Build and test in ChatGPT sandbox or on your own computer through GitHub.
interface.longDescription: Local Agent gives ChatGPT a bounded development workflow with GitHub as the durable source/control plane. Software-only work can prefer the ChatGPT sandbox with reproducible offline packs stored in ChatGPT Library, while machine-specific builds, devices, local files, and hardware can be delegated to an optional Local Agent executor on the user's computer.
defaultPrompt: Choose the cheapest safe worker for this repository and run the relevant checks.
Use the ChatGPT sandbox for software-only verification when a compatible offline pack is available.
Use Local Agent only when this task genuinely needs my computer or connected hardware.
